. /home/probe/session-env; set -eu; date -u +%FT%T.%N; gdbus call --session --dest org.gnome.Mutter.DisplayConfig --object-path /org/gnome/Mutter/DisplayConfig --method org.gnome.Mutter.DisplayConfig.GetCurrentState; timeout 15 /usr/bin/python3 /home/probe/source-input/geometry-oracle/snapshot-guest.py; for pid in 34063 34825 34918; do printf 'CAPTURE_BASELINE_PID=%s
' "$pid"; ps -p "$pid" -o pid,lstart,args; cat "/proc/$pid/stat"; readlink "/proc/$pid/exe"; done; gsettings get org.gnome.shell.keybindings show-screenshot-ui; gsettings get org.gnome.shell.keybindings show-screen-recording-ui; gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.lockdown disable-save-to-disk; if command -v xdg-user-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then xdg-user-dir PICTURES; xdg-user-dir VIDEOS; fi; timeout 15 find /home/probe -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -iname '*.png' -o -iname '*.webm' -o -iname '*.mp4' \) -printf '%T@ %s %p
' > /home/probe/evidence/capture-round4-before-files.txt; cat /home/probe/evidence/capture-round4-before-files.txt; printf 'ROUND4_PRE_UI_STATE_COMPLETE
'

'; base64 "$archive"; printf 'PACKAGE_BUILD_PROVENANCE_BASE64_END
'; printf 'ROUND4_PACKAGE_BUILD_PROVENANCE_COMPLETE
